svg.aria-label: Workflow: a Claude Code Workflow script, run as a governed pipeline in the cloud
svg.title: Workflow: a Claude Code Workflow script, run as a governed pipeline in the cloud
svg.text: Workflow: a Claude Code Workflow script, run as a governed pipeline in the cloud
Same agent() / parallel() / pipeline() / phase() dialect as the local Workflow tool. Every agent() call is a governed invocation; the script never sees the backend's AWS identity.

① trigger (portal, or EventBridge Scheduler → Lambda) ② engine starts the script in a sandboxed Node child ③ each agent() returns over the stdio bridge into quota → invoke → ledger ④ fan-out across runtime sessions ⑤ one trace per run
